title: ArchiveHandler subclassing crashes with AttributeError on __abstractmethods__
description: Defining a concrete ArchiveHandler subclass raises AttributeError: __abstractmethods__ before any handler can be implemented. Root cause: __init_subclass__ at backend/services/qe_archive/handlers/contract.py:132-135 reads cls.__abstractmethods__ directly while ABCMeta has not yet populated that attribute on the subclass. Impact: PaperV2ArchiveHandler / FactorValueArchiveHandler cannot be declared, so the T14a interface contract is unusable. Fix uses getattr(cls, '__abstractmethods__', None) safe-check, with ABCMeta still enforcing required abstract methods on the final pass. P1.1 of Codex T12+T14a review.
